title: Degree-zero line-tensor constructions and their K-flat normalization
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with site object universe $t+1$, morphism universe $t$, and coefficient universe $r=\max(a,t+1)$ in which the site is essentially small. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings and write $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ for the existing module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix the localization universe of the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ and write $Q$ for localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For arbitrary module sheaves $P,N$, define $P^\vee=\mathcal Hom_R(P,R)$ using the internal sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom], $T_P=-\otimes_R P$ using the existing sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], its inherited additive structure, and $P[0]$ using the degree-zero single complex. Define the pure tensor of local sections to be their presheaf tensor followed by the sheafification unit and the canonical tensor/sheafification identification. Given an isomorphism $e:P\otimes_R N\cong R$, define the cancellation isomorphism $T_N\circ T_P\cong1$ by reassociation, tensoring with $e$, and the right unitor.

Use the total and derived tensor and resolving comparison of [def-sf-ringed-kflat-tensor-representative-data]. Define $\operatorname{collapse}_P:\operatorname{Tot}(-\otimes_R P[0])\cong T_P$ on cochain complexes to be the canonical degree-zero single-factor collapse, and define $F_P=-\otimes_R^L Q(P[0])$ by fixing the right argument of that published derived bifunctor. Suppose $P[0]$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every term of $P[0]$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For a functor $F:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$, an equality $h:F=F_P$, any unbounded complex $K$, and an isomorphism $c:F(QK)\cong Q(T_PK)$, define $\operatorname{normalization}(P,h,K,c)$ to mean that, for every proof that $K$ is K-flat and has flat terms, $c$ equals the composite of the transport along $h$, the inverse of the published comparison $Q\operatorname{Tot}(K\otimes_R P[0])\cong F_P(QK)$, and $Q(\operatorname{collapse}_{P,K})$. These are existing constructions and a comparison predicate; no local freeness, exactness, or inverse-equivalence assertion is part of this definition.
